summary: Skier-triggered avalanche shortly before 1 p.m. on closed inbounds terrain at Steamboat Resort; about eight skiers caught in the slide, one fully buried and dug out by rescuers; the buried skier was transported to UCHealth Yampa Valley Medical Center in good condition.
notes: Date pinned to Sunday 2019-12-15 (weekday-verified): the TMJ4 story, published ~2019-12-16, says the slide was triggered "shortly before 1 p.m. Sunday"; original reporting by the Steamboat Pilot & Today. The ~8 skiers were inbounds and did not cross ropes; the slide was triggered from below in closed terrain during avalanche-control operations. merged KVNF regional newscast (Dec 16, 2019): 'Steamboat Springs Search and Rescue perform heroic save of buried skier'. | MERGED run 813: Kool 107.9 piece (parent-opened) on the same 2019-12-15 Steamboat Resort inbounds avalanche — persistent hard slab, ~8 skiers involved, Ski Patrol on scene in 3-4 min, buried skier out by 1:05, transported to hospital.
